title: Light neutrinos, Dark matter and leptogenesis near electroweak scale and $Z_4$ symmetry
summary: Considering $Z_4$ symmetry in Type I seesaw scenario, one could obtain mass-squared differences of light neutrinos, mixings and $CP$ violating phase within $3 σ$ confidence level based on neutrino oscillation data. This is possible with only three independent complex parameters for allowed Yukawa couplings and one real mass parameter for heavy right handed neutrino fields around electroweak scale. After considering only three more real parameters as coming from small soft-symmetry breaking terms, the lightest right handed neutrino could be considered as dark matter candidate via freeze-in…
